title: Raghav's two wall clocks
description: Two wall clocks above two yoga mats, captioned Before yoga and After yoga, with the hands in different places on each clock and no times written.

title: Zainab's colouring time
labels: Zainab started colouring at 04:25 p.m. and stopped at 05:10 p.m.
description: A time line from 04:25 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. with a hop of 35 minutes up to 05:00 p.m. and a hop of 10 minutes to 05:10 p.m., and 45 minutes in all written below.

title: A day on one strip
description: A strip of 24 hour boxes from 00 to 23 with an a.m. side and a p.m. side, a marker at 07:45 p.m. in box 19 labelled 19:45 hours, and 7 + 12 = 19 written below.

title: A drawing class in 24-hour time
labels: A drawing class starts at 13:40 hours and ends at 16:15 hours
description: A time line from 13:40 hours to 16:15 hours with hops of 20 minutes, 2 hours and 15 minutes, and 2 hours 35 minutes written below.

title: A race time of 01:48
description: A race clock display reading 01:48, with a bar of 1 minute joined to a bar of 48 seconds and 60 + 48 = 108 seconds written below.

title: The seconds hand from 3 to 8
labels: Remo timed himself tying his shoe
description: A seconds dial with a ghost hand on 3 and a red hand on 8, the stretch between them shaded, and 40 − 15 = 25 seconds written beside it.

title: The seconds hand runs 25 seconds from 10
labels: The seconds hand runs for 25 seconds
description: A seconds dial with a ghost hand on 10 and a red hand on 3, the stretch passing 12 shaded, and the working written beside it.

title: Hours and minutes on a double number line
labels: Hours and minutes on a double number line
description: A double number line with hours 0 to 6 above and minutes 0 to 360 below, an arrow marked × 60, and 5 hours = 5 × 60 = 300 minutes written below.

title: Minutes and seconds on a double number line
labels: Minutes and seconds on a double number line
description: A double number line with minutes 0 to 5 above and seconds 0 to 300 below, an arrow marked × 60, and a short extra hop of 30 seconds after 240 to 270.

title: Zainab's painting from 03:20 p.m.
labels: Zainab starts painting at 03:20 p.m. and paints for 1 hour 50 minutes
description: A time line from 03:20 p.m. to 05:10 p.m. with a hop of 1 hour, a hop of 40 minutes and a hop of 10 minutes.

title: Remo's reading back from 08:15 p.m.
labels: Remo finished reading at 08:15 p.m. after 2 hours 40 minutes
description: A time line from 08:15 p.m. going back to 05:35 p.m. with a hop back of 2 hours, a hop back of 15 minutes and a hop back of 25 minutes.

title: A journey across midnight
labels: A train leaves at 10:15 p.m. and the journey takes 5 hours 45 minutes
description: A time line from 10:00 p.m. to 05:00 a.m. with midnight marked and a hop from 10:15 p.m. to 04:00 a.m. the next day, with the 24-hour count to 28:00 hours written under it.

title: The units of time
labels: The units of time in this chapter
description: Three rows of a box, an arrow and a box: 1 hour to 60 minutes, 1 minute to 60 seconds, and 07:45 p.m. to 19:45 hours.
